generated.title: Why Can't We Predict Earthquakes? #shorts

Why can't scientists predict exactly when the next big earthquake will strike?

Scientists can identify dangerous faults and estimate earthquake probabilities, but predicting the exact time, location, and magnitude of a future earthquake remains beyond our capabilities.
